abstract: Pinned GSAP ScrollTrigger hero that scrubs one Blob-preloaded MP4 through a lerped, seek-coalesced rAF loop, with streaming load progress, a ready-gate timeout falling back to a stills crossfade, a reduced-motion path, mobile source selection and data-attribute config. Ships a no-build template with unit-tested pure logic, encoding recipes, a DevTools probe, and an inspection guide.
